dedupe_keys.name: maximizing storage in island park reservoir idaho under varying hydrologic regimes and environmental flow requirements

description: Maximizing storage in Island Park Reservoir, Idaho under varying hydrologic regimes and environmental flow requirements is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Christina Morrisett (deposited on HydroShare). This report details a model that uses a nonlinear penalty function in a linear reservoir optimization model to identify a monthly reservoir release strategy that maximizes end-of-water-year storage in Island Park Reservoir, while satisfying habitat and flow requirements for fish and anglers. Coverage: Idaho, United States. The resource was created 2019-02-20 and last updated 2019-02-20; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
